variant.headline: Automated - except the last click
variant.body: Everything up to submission runs on its own; you press Submit yourself. A ToS-safe design, on purpose.
variant.source_evidence: youtube_hooks.json[en]: 훅유형 '역설·반전' 가중 비중 0.0 views/day (share_pct_by_views 기준 apportion) -> 구조 템플릿 '통념 제시 + '그런데/사실은' 반전 + 실제 사실' 적용

top_blockers: The copy never says what is being matched, so its relevance to her operations work is unclear.
A ToS-safe automated matching tool has nothing to do with her transportation attendant work or community hobbies.
It never names what gets matched or submitted, so the STEM tinkerer can't tell if it's useful or a spammy bot.
Automated submission matching is irrelevant to a semi-retired nurse focused on palliative care and gardening.
Without knowing what is matched, the detail-oriented auditor can't judge if it fits her audit or ESG interests.
